chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Suleyman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who drinks wine, so whip him. So if he repeats, so whip him. So if he repeats for the third time, so kill him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a person who drinks wine three times according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the hadd punishment for wine consumption, prescribing flogging for the first two offenses and execution for the third, a ruling supported by the majority of Shia jurists. While some scholars debate whether the execution is a specific hadd or a discretionary ta'zir, the text reflects the early Islamic legal tradition where the Prophet Muhammad (saww) instituted this graduated discipline to deter habitual intoxication. The progression underscores the severity of losing one's faculties, which is viewed as a gateway to other sins.
